days.teaser: Learn the applicant checklists, flagging and stamping.
Graduating students file their clearances. Some are missing requirements.
Sections fill up fast. Move students into an open section with no clash.
Unpaid balances. Those students go to the Cashier.
Freshmen locked out of ISMIS. Reset their logins at the window.
The hardest day: every problem at once, seats draining live and rush waves.
Adviser signatures, fake signatures and the Hold bench.
Overloads over 24 units go to the Dean's office.
Only listed departments may adjust. Turn the rest away politely.
The payment window: match the cash to the assessment.
